verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev's own observability feature sends alerts to webhooks when tasks fail, so it does offer outbound HTTP callbacks. That support is documented only as a single product-page line about failure alerts, not a general event-subscription system. Missing for 10: webhook support for event types beyond task failures (e.g. run completed or state changes), documented registration/configuration and payload schema, delivery guarantees or signing details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Receive alerts via email, Slack notification and webhooks when your tasks fail.
